observations: Roles 646–647 retain room, storey, roof and complete BuildingPlan records with a mixture of source recipe values, semantic assembly IDs and raw serialized geometry. RoundTower separately checks anchor/diameter parity at construction and deserialization, but its other public numeric and interface fields, roof graph relationships and whole-plan validation need separate tracing.

Role 648 defines purpose-specific structural IDs and shape payloads. ResolvedSolid deserialization re-admits its native cuboid envelope through CollisionCuboid while separately retaining raw shape and support references; leaf envelope validation alone does not prove the shape, identity or support graph coherent.

Role 649 admits a bounded u16 room ordinal, but the value alone cannot establish membership in a particular storey. Role 650 retains source wall frames, opening profile payloads, closure policies and referenced solids/nodes; cross-field relationships, frame restrictions and canonical ownership remain independent obligations.
